actionCalls.description: Gets the value for a specified attribute from a JSON object that has been serialized into a string.
actionCalls.name: GetUserDatafromJSONString
actionCalls.label: Get User Data from JSON String

assignments.description: (Optional) Assigns the user ID for the updated linked user to an output variable so that the Salesforce runtime can complete additional assignments, such as assigning permission sets.
assignments.name: AssignLinkedUserIdToOutput
assignments.label: Assign Linked User ID to Output

assignments.description: Assigns the user ID for the updated user to an output variable so that the Salesforce runtime can complete additional assignments, such as assigning permission sets.
assignments.name: AssignUpdatedUserIdToOutput
assignments.label: Assign Updated User ID to Output Variable

decisions.description: Determines whether the user has previously authenticated with this provider by looking up the remote identifier to see if there is a ThirdPartyAccountLink with a corresponding user ID.
decisions.name: IsThirdPartyAccountLinked
decisions.label: Is Third-Party Account Linked?

decisions.description: Determines whether to create a user or update an existing user by checking if there is a user record with attributes that match attributes in the Auth.UserData object.
decisions.name: WasExistingUserFound
decisions.label: Was Existing User Found?

Flow.description: Finds a user during during the State of Hawaii Entra ID single sign-on process.
Flow.label: Entra ID OIDC SSO Registration Handler

recordLookups.description: Looks for a user record with attributes, such as email address, that match attributes from the Apex Auth.UserData record.
recordLookups.name: FindExistingUser
recordLookups.label: Find Existing User

recordUpdates.description: Updates the existing user record with data supplied by the identity provider.
recordUpdates.name: UpdateExistingUser
recordUpdates.label: Update Existing User

recordUpdates.description: Updates the user record associated with the user ID from the ThirdPartyAccountLink with data supplied by the identity provider.
recordUpdates.name: UpdateLinkedUser
recordUpdates.label: Update Linked User

variables.description: Stores an Apex Auth.UserData record that contains information about the user from the identity provider. This record is passed into the flow.
variables.name: authUserData

variables.description: Stores the ID for the account that the new or updated user is added to by default, as defined in the authentication provider configuration.
variables.name: defaultAccountId

variables.description: (Required) Stores the ID for the profile that the new or updated user is added to by default, as defined in the authentication provider configuration.
variables.name: defaultProfileId

variables.description: Stores the user ID from the associated ThirdPartyAccountLink, if a link exists.
variables.name: existingUserIdFromTpal

variables.description: Stores a federation identifier from the identity provider.
variables.name: federationIdentifier

variables.description: Indicates whether the user is an external user logging in to an Experience Cloud site (true) or an internal user logging in to a Salesforce org (false).
variables.name: isExternalUser

variables.description: If the authentication provider is used for an Experience Cloud site, stores the Experience Cloud site ID.
variables.name: networkId

variables.description: Stores a collection of permission set API names to add to the created or updated user.
variables.name: permissionSetsToAdd

variables.description: Stores a collection of permission set API names to remove from the updated user.
variables.name: permissionSetsToRemove

variables.description: Stores the user ID of the created or updated user in an output variable that can be used by the Salesforce runtime for additional assignments, such as permission set assignments.
variables.name: userIdOutput
